name: terranode
description: TerraNode — tokenizing land restoration to offset AI compute footprint

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --prefix client && echo 'Client built to client/dist'
scripts.start:prod: SERVE_CLIENT=true NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix server
